name: lj-nve-demo
description: Tiny LAMMPS Lennard-Jones NVE demo: 27 atoms on a simple-cubic lattice, integrated with `fix nve`. Emits temperature, potential_energy, kinetic_energy, total_energy, pressure, and volume each step.

interval.description: Process interval in LJ time units. The bridge issues `run N` calls sized to fit this window.

lattice_density.description: Reduced density of the simple-cubic lattice used to seed atoms.

initial_temperature.description: Reduced temperature used by `velocity all create` for initial Maxwell-Boltzmann sampling.

config.input_script:
units lj
atom_style atomic
dimension 3
boundary p p p
lattice sc 0.5
region box block 0 3 0 3 0 3
create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 box
mass 1 1.0
pair_style lj/cut 2.5
pair_coeff 1 1 1.0 1.0
pair_modify shift yes
velocity all create 1.0 87287 dist gaussian
timestep 0.005
fix integ all nve
